confidence_notes: The FX rate comes from the RBA search result: 0.6720 USD per AUD on 2026-11-18. I did not open the RBA page myself. Food and drink figures come from one cost-of-living search, which returned crowd-sourced mylifeelsewhere.com data and Expat Arrivals national Thailand prices. Those sources gave beer at about $2.8, a cappuccino at about $2.5, an inexpensive meal at about $3.1 and a mid-range meal for two at about THB 1,000. The search found no cocktail or wine prices. I set cocktail and wine as multiples of the beer price: cocktail about 3x and wine about 3.5x, which reflects Thailand's high alcohol taxes. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge, with no live listings checked. The pricing window is July 2026, but the data found is not dated to that window. Hotel and hostel prices vary widely by area and season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Bangkok-specific crowd-sourced price indexes and Thailand national averages. Accommodation is benchmarked against typical Southeast Asian capital-city tourist pricing.
